provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source review and execution audit
limitations: Not executed. The program assumes a single solid rectangle in mask colour palette[8], with the pattern built by the constructor. The baked-in axis offsets assume square grids of side 4*block-2, as in the generator; for other shapes the data-driven fallback detects the axis. Stage 2 relies on random content making false diagonal matches with at least 10 agreements and zero disagreements astronomically unlikely. The final most-common-colour fallback is only a safety net and is never needed for constructor-valid boxes. The fixtures are consistent with the uniform rule; no contradictions were found.
